info.title: GetSellerPerformance
info.description: Provide the performance metrics of the current seller, such as positive seller rating, ship on time, etc.

get.description: Provide the performance metrics of the current seller, such as positive seller rating, ship on time, etc.

success.description: true for success, false for error.

indicators.name: Positive Seller Rating
indicators.tip:
Positive Seller Rating

The ratio of total positive ratings to total ratings from verified buyers. This is measured for period of last 8 weeks.

children.name: seller_id
children.desc: Seller ID.

children.name: main_category_id
children.desc: Seller's main category ID.

children.name: main_category_name
children.desc: Seller's main category name.

children.name: type
children.desc: Indicator type (e.g. POSITIVE_SELLER_RATING, PRODUCT_RATING_COVERAGE, ...).

children.name: name
children.desc: Name of the indicator is the seller's language.

children.name: tip
children.desc: Longer description of the indicator is the seller's language.

children.name: score
children.desc: Raw score value. Note: if the indicator doesn't contain any value, a null value is set instead.

children.name: score_format
children.desc: Score format: INTEGER, DOUBLE, PERCENTAGE, MINUTES, HOURS.

children.name: formatted_score
children.desc: Score formatted in the seller's language and locale. Note: if the indicator doesn't contain any value, a "-" is set instead.

children.name: target
children.desc: Indicator target (raw value). Note: if the indicator doesn't contain any value, a null value is set instead.

children.name: target_format
children.desc: Target format: GREATER_THAN_DOUBLE ('≥' #.##), GREATER_THAN_PERCENTAGE ('≥' #.##'%'), LOWER_THAN_PERCENTAGE('≤' #.##'%'), LOWER_THAN_MINUTES('≤' #'min'), STRICTLY_LOWER_THAN_HOURS('<' #'h'), GREATER_THAN_DOUBLE ('≥' #.##), EQUALS_TO_INTEGER(= #).

children.name: formatted_target
children.desc: Indicator target formatted in the seller's language and locale.

children.name: target_respected
children.desc: true if the formattedScore respects the formattedTarget, false if not.

children.name: action_url
children.desc: Relative (from the Seller Portal) or absolute URL to redirect the seller to the page where he cans handle the task.

children.name: indicators
children.desc: Performance indicators.
